en: A historical black-and-white photograph depicting a grand, tree-lined urban street with imposing late 19th-century or early 20th-century buildings on both sides. Several people are walking, a mounted policeman in uniform is prominent in the center, and horse-drawn carriages are seen, hinting at a pre-automobile era. There are street signs and business signs on the buildings. The overall setting is distinctly European.
